description.value:
Requirement You have successfully Named an Anchor of the same type before.

Duration for the rest of the encounter

Recall an Anchor-type you've Named before instantly, without a new check, if you've faced its like already.

You have seen this one's like. The target is Named immediately, with no action and no check. Whether two hauntings share an Anchor-type is the GM's call, and the Manifest is why you know: §6 assumes Ashroad Circuit membership or good standing for this feat, or secondhand access through a rider who owes you.

cinderfall.incomplete: This keys off the homebrew 'Named' tag, which has no rule-element representation anywhere in this class: name-the-anchor.json itself (the card that would apply the tag) ships rules: [] and has no companion Effect item or roll-option that flags a specific creature. There is nothing to hook into until/unless that foundational mechanic gets built. (instantly Names a target with no action or check, based on a prior successful Naming of the same Anchor-type.)
